description_sq:
Apartament 2+1 te HORA VERTIKALE, nje projekt bashkekohor qe po zhvillohet ne nje nga zonat me te mira te Tiranes.
Me nje siperfaqe totale prej 147 m² (115 m² neto dhe 32 m² siperfaqe te perbashketa), ky apartament ofron nje organizim funksional dhe hapesira te bollshme: sallon ndenjeje me kuzhine te integruar, dy dhoma gjumi, dy tualete dhe nje ballkon.
Nje ambient ideal per banim komod, me ndricim natyral dhe pamje te hapur.
Duke qene se projekti ndodhet ne fazat e para te ndertimit, perben nje mundesi shume te mire investimi ne kohe, me potencial te larte rritjeje vlere dhe standard te larte ndertimi.
description_en: 2+1 apartment in HORA VERTIKALE, a contemporary project that is being developed in one of the best areas of Tirana. With a total area of ​​147 m² (115 m² net and 32 m² common area), this apartment offers a functional organization and ample spaces: living room with integrated kitchen, two bedrooms, two bathrooms and a balcony. An ideal environment for comfortable living, with natural lighting and an open view. Since the project is in the first stages of construction, it is a very good opportunity to invest in time, with high potential for value growth and a high standard of construction.
